verdict.rationale: Perplexity Sonar API is a SaaS API rather than an agent, so the server axis applies. Its first-party docs describe an official MCP server: a hosted remote endpoint at api.perplexity.ai/mcp that works with any remote-MCP client, plus an open-source local stdio option. The docs also cover tool restriction and MCP-connector usage, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents successfully connect and use the server in practice.
